name: House Baratheon
description: House Baratheon of Storm's End is one of the Great Houses of Westeros, and is the principal house in the stormlands, which they rule as Lords Paramount of the Stormlands. Their seat, Storm's End, is an ancient castle raised by the Storm Kings from the now-extinct House Durrandon. The Baratheon sigil is a crowned black stag on a field of gold. Their words are "Ours is the Fury". After Robert's Rebellion, House Baratheon split into three branches: Lord Robert Baratheon was crowned king and took residence at King's Landing, thereby creating House Baratheon of King's Landing. Robert gave the seat of Dragonstone to his younger brother, Stannis, creating House Baratheon of Dragonstone. Robert's youngest brother, Renly, became the Lord of Storm's End, continuing House Baratheon of Storm's End. Members of the family tend to be tall and powerfully built, with black hair and blue eyes, as well as strong, square jawlines. They are known for their mercurial tempers. Vassals: House Caron, House Connington, House Dondarrion, House Errol, House Estermont, House Fell, House Grandison, House Lonmouth, House Morrigen, House Musgood, House Peasebury, House Penros, House Seaworth, House Selmy, House Swann, House Tarth, House Trant, House Wylde. Robert Baratheon: The head of House Baratheon, King of the Seven Kingdoms, married to Cersei Lannister. Queen Cersei Baratheon (formerly Lannister) - Robert's wife and queen consort. Prince Joffrey Baratheon - Robert and Cersei's eldest son and heir to the Iron Throne. Prince Tommen Baratheon - Robert and Cersei's younger son. Princess Myrcella Baratheon - Robert and Cersei's daughter.

goals.description: Preserve House Baratheon's lands, lineage, and political position
Advance House Baratheon's influence within The Stormlands

name: House Baratheon (Renly)
description: Renly Baratheon, the youngest brother, has no legal claim to the throne ahead of Stannis - and does not care. Charismatic, beloved, and backed by the enormous wealth and armies of the Reach through his marriage to Margaery Tyrell, Renly commands the largest army in Westeros. His court is a tournament, his war a pageant. He believes the realm needs a king people want to follow, not one they're obligated to obey.
hiddenInfo: Renly's marriage to Margaery is a political arrangement - he is secretly in a relationship with Loras Tyrell, Margaery's brother. The Tyrells know this and consider it useful leverage. Renly's enormous army has never actually fought a battle and may prove less formidable than its numbers suggest.

goals.description: March on King's Landing and take the Iron Throne by show of overwhelming force
Convince the remaining lords that charisma and popular support outweigh birth order
Neutralize Stannis before he becomes a rallying point for legalists

territory: Parts of the Reach (via Tyrell alliance)

name: House Baratheon (Stannis)
description: Stannis Baratheon, Lord of Dragonstone, is Robert's elder brother and by law the rightful heir to the Iron Throne - a fact he pursues with iron determination and zero charm. Rigid, just, and utterly humorless, Stannis commands a modest fleet and a smaller army but wields something more dangerous: a legitimate claim and a red priestess who whispers of destiny in his ear. Melisandre's fire magic is real, and Stannis is pragmatic enough to use it.
hiddenInfo: Melisandre possesses genuine power - shadow magic, visions in flame, and rituals that demand blood sacrifice. Stannis is pragmatic enough to use tools others would reject on principle. His conversion to R'hllor alienates many traditional Westerosi lords who see it as foreign heresy.

goals.description: Claim the Iron Throne as Robert's lawful heir
Expose Cersei's children as illegitimate bastards born of incest
Outmaneuver Renly and consolidate the Baratheon claim under one banner
Win the support of the Stormlands lords who currently favor Renly

name: House Blackmont
description: House Blackmont of Blackmont is a major Dornish noble house. Their seat, Blackmont, is on the banks of the Torentine in the Red Mountains of Dorne. House Blackmont has very little Rhoynar ancestry compared to other Dornish houses, as they primarily descend from the First Men and Andals. This makes them light-haired and light-skinned. House Blackmont's sigil is a black vulture with a pink infant in its claws on a yellow field. Lady Larra Blackmont is the Lady of Blackmont and the head of the house. Jynessa Blackmont is her daughter and heir to Blackmont. Perros Blackmont is her son, a squire. Lady Larra has a few younger children who are among the favorite children hosted by Doran Martell, Prince of Dorne, at the Water Gardens.

goals.description: Preserve House Blackmont's lands, lineage, and political position
Advance House Blackmont's influence within Dorne

name: House Blackwood
description: House Blackwood of Raventree Hall is an old house from Raventree Hall in the riverlands, one of the main families sworn to House Tully of Riverrun. Their sigil is a flock of ravens surrounding a black shield charged with a dead weirwood, on a scarlet field. Blackwoods are mostly slim, with black hair. Their words are "Always Watching". Their vassals are House Blanetree, House Ryger. The current ruling lord of House Blackwood is Tytos Blackwood.

goals.description: Preserve House Blackwood's lands, lineage, and political position
Advance House Blackwood's influence within The Riverlands

name: House Bolton
description: The Boltons of the Dreadfort are the Starks' most dangerous vassals - an ancient house whose sigil is a flayed man and whose ancestors wore the skins of their enemies. Roose Bolton is quiet, pale-eyed, and terrifyingly controlled. He speaks in whispers, leeches himself daily, and calculates every interaction for advantage. Officially loyal to Robb Stark, Roose Bolton fights in the Northern army. But Bolton loyalty has always been conditional.
hiddenInfo: Roose Bolton's loyalty is conditional and self-serving. He has a pattern of preserving Bolton forces while positioning rival Northern houses in harm's way. His bastard son Ramsay is a sadist operating semi-independently from the Dreadfort - torturing, hunting humans for sport, and terrorizing the northern countryside. Bolton ambition runs deeper than anyone suspects.

goals.description: Position House Bolton to supplant the Starks as dominant Northern power
Weaken rival Northern houses while maintaining the appearance of loyalty
Cultivate contingency alliances outside the Northern coalition

name: House Bracken
description: House Bracken of Stone Hedge is an old house from Stone Hedge in the Riverlands, one of the main families sworn to House Tully of Riverrun. Their lands are located along the banks of the Red Fork of the Trident. They rule over wider domains and can field a much larger army than their overlord of House Tully. The sigil of House Bracken is a crimson stallion upon a saffron background. Their words are "Fear Our Thunder", referencing the sound of galloping stallions. The current lord of House Bracken is Jonos Bracken. The Brackens hold an ancient grudge against their neighbors, the Blackwoods of Raventree Hall.

goals.description: Preserve House Bracken's lands, lineage, and political position
Advance House Bracken's influence within The Riverlands

name: House Cerwyn
description: House Cerwyn of Cerwyn is a noble house from the north. They are one of the closest bannermen to the Starks, Castle Cerwyn being just a half day's ride from Winterfell, and are among the most powerful as well. House Cerwyn's heraldry is a black battle-axe on silver. Their words are "Honed and Ready". The current ruler of House Cerwyn is Lord Medger Cerwyn. He and his wife have a son - Lord Cley Cerwyn, and a daughter - Lady Jonelle Cerwyn.

goals.description: Preserve House Cerwyn's lands, lineage, and political position
Advance House Cerwyn's influence within The North

name: House Clegane
description: House Clegane (noble family) Description: House Clegane is a minor noble house whose origins date back to being commoners. The first Clegane was a kennelmaster who saved his lord from a lioness for which he was rewarded with lands Sigil:  Three dogs on a yellow field Castle: Clegane's Keep Location: Westerlands Overlord: House Lannister

goals.description: Preserve House Clegane's place in Westerosi politics

name: House Corbray
description: House Corbray of Heart's Home is a vassal house which holds fealty to House Arryn of the Eyrie. It is an old but poor house. The ancestral Valyrian steel longsword of the Corbrays is Lady Forlorn. Lady Forlorn has a heart-shaped ruby in its pommel. The sigil of House Corbray features three black ravens in flight holding three red hearts on a white background. Their vassals are House Dutton and House Crayne. The current ruler of House Corbray is Lord Lyonel Corbray. His wife, the daughter of a rich merchant of Gulltown, is pregnant with Lyonel's child.

goals.description: Preserve House Corbray's lands, lineage, and political position
Advance House Corbray's influence among Westerosi houses

name: House Crakehall
description: House Crakehall is a vassal house that holds fealty to House Lannister of Casterly Rock. Their lands are located at the Searoad, at the south of the Westerlands, between the sea and a large forest. The current head of the family is Desmond Crakehall. The Crakehall sigil is a black and white brindled boar on brown. Their house words are "None So Fierce." Vassals of House Crakehall: House Hawthorne, House Parren, House Stackspear. Lord Roland Crakehall is Lord of Crakehall. Ser Tybolt Crakehall is his eldest son and heir to Crakehall. Ser Lyle Crakehall is his second son, called Strongboar. Ser Merlon Crakehall is his third son.

goals.description: Preserve House Crakehall's lands, lineage, and political position
Advance House Crakehall's influence within The Westerlands

name: House Daerys
description: House Daerys is an Old Blood house of Volantis with wealth 70, influence 65, and military strength 50 on the Volantene scale. Its holdings include The Black Fang, Shipyards, Pirate-hunting privateers. Strong naval presence and anti-piracy operations.

goals.description: Advance House Daerys's interests inside Old Blood politics without being swallowed by Balaerys power

name: House Dayne
description: House Dayne, a vassal of House Martell in Dorne, holds the castle of Starfall. Their ancestral weapon is Dawn, a blade forged from a fallen star. The wielder of Dawn is bestowed the title "the Sword of the Morning". Daynes are known for their hair, which can be pale blond, dark, or silver with a black streak, and their eyes, often dark blue or purple. House Dayne has a cadet branch, House Dayne of High Hermitage. Their sigil displays a white sword and falling star on a lilac field. Notably, House Dayne has two tragic figures: Ser Arthur Dayne, the Sword of the Morning, who perished at the Skirmish at the Tower of Joy, and Lady Ashara Dayne, who took her own life at Starfall. The current ruler, Edric Dayne, possesses fair, pale blond hair and dark blue eyes that resemble purple. He wears a pale purple cloak. While initially shy, Edric is known for his good-natured and polite demeanor.

goals.description: Preserve House Dayne's lands, lineage, and political position
Advance House Dayne's influence within Dorne

name: House Dustin
description: House Dustin is a major house in the North of Westeros, sworn to House Stark of Winterfell. Their castle is Barrow Hall in Barrowton, a prominent town in the north. Their sigil is a crown and longaxes on a yellow background. Their words are "Our Word Yet Lives". he current head of the house is Lady Barbrey Dustin, a Ryswell by birth. She is the widow of Willam Dustin, Lord of Barrowton. Barbrey is tall, unbent, and handsome. She has wrinkles around her mouth and dark eyes, and her hair is equal parts brown and grey. Lady Dustin wears her hair tied behind her head in a widow's knot. While intelligent, Barbrey has grown into a bitter woman over the years. Lady Dustin is distrustful of maesters and refers to them as grey rats. House Dustin has a few vassal houses, including House Stout of Goldgrass.

goals.description: Preserve House Dustin's lands, lineage, and political position
Advance House Dustin's influence within The North

name: House Flint
description: House Flint of Widow's Watch is a noble house in the North. They hold fealty to House Stark of Winterfell. Their banner is a blue field strewn with whitecaps, on a yellow chief with crested line there's a pair of blue eyes. Their words are "Ever Vigilant". Lady Lyessa Flint is the head of the house. House Flint has vassals known as the Flints of the Mountains and House Flint of Flint's Finger.

goals.description: Preserve House Flint's lands, lineage, and political position
Advance House Flint's influence within The North

name: House Florent
description: House Florent of Brightwater Keep is a vassal house that holds fealty to House Tyrell. Their seat is Brightwater Keep. Their sigil is a red-gold fox's head encircled by lapis lazuli flowers. Selyse Florent is the wife of Stannis Baratheon. Members of House Florent tend to have prominent ears. The current ruler is Ser Colin Florent, who has 3 chldren: Delena Florent, married to Ser Hosman Norcross; Omer Florent, a maester of the Citadel in service at Old Oak; Merrell Florent, a squire at the Arbor.

goals.description: Preserve House Florent's lands, lineage, and political position
Advance House Florent's influence among Westerosi houses

name: House Fowler
description: House Fowler of Skyreach is a noble house from Skyreach in Dorne. They hold the title of "Warden of the Prince's Pass" and watch over the Prince's Pass. The sigil of House Fowler is a hooded azure hawk on an argent (silver) field. The words of House Fowler are "Let Me Soar". House Fowler are vassals of House Yronwood. The current lord of House Fowler is Franklyn Fowler, called the Old Hawk. He is the father of the Fowler twins: Jennelyn Fowler and Jeyne Fowler, both are tall women with wispy yellow hair. In their youth twins played with Princess Arianne Martell in the pools of the Water Gardens.

goals.description: Preserve House Fowler's lands, lineage, and political position
Advance House Fowler's influence within The Reach

name: House Frey
description: The Freys control the Twins - the only bridge crossing of the Green Fork for hundreds of miles. Lord Walder Frey is ancient, bitter, and transactional. He has outlived four wives, sired dozens of children and bastards, and spent ninety years being slighted by every great house in Westeros. He sells his bridge crossing to the highest bidder and nurses grudges like vintage wine. His loyalty lasts exactly as long as the deal that purchased it.
hiddenInfo: Walder Frey is fundamentally transactional - he arrived late to Robert's Rebellion and has never forgotten the scorn it earned him. He considers every alliance a contract, and any perceived breach of terms is met with disproportionate spite. The Freys keep channels open to multiple sides at all times.

goals.description: Secure a royal marriage for House Frey to elevate their status
Extract maximum concessions from whoever needs to cross the Twins
Ensure House Frey survives the war on the winning side

name: House Gargalen
description: House Gargalen of Salt Shore is a major Dornish noble house. Their seat, Salt Shore, is located along the Summer Sea on the southern coast of Dorne. Deceased Doran Martell, the former Prince of Dorne, squired for Lord Gargalen in his youth. The sigil of House Gargalen is a red cockatrice with a black snake in its beak on a golden field. Lord Tremond Gargalen, the Lord of Salt Shore, is the head of the house.

goals.description: Preserve House Gargalen's lands, lineage, and political position
Advance House Gargalen's influence within Dorne

name: House Glover
description: House Glover of Deepwood Motte is a noble house from the north, sworn to the Starks of Winterfell. Galbart Glover is the Master of Deepwood Motte, which is located in the northwestern wolfswood. Houses Bole, Branch, Forrester, and Woods of the wolfswood are sworn to the Glovers. The sigil of House Glover is a silver mailed fist on scarlet. Their words are "With a Firm Hand". The current ruler of House Glover is Galbart Glover. Robett Glover is Galbart's younger brother and successor. Robett Glover is the husband of Sybelle Glover, and the father of two children, Gawen and Erena. Robett is tall, with a deeply-lined face and brown-grey hair. He wears mail beneath a red surcoat, and his scarlet cloak is clasped with a silver brooch in the shape of a mailed fist. Sybelle Glover is a pious woman who often prays in Deepwood's godswood.

goals.description: Preserve House Glover's lands, lineage, and political position
Advance House Glover's influence within The North

name: House Greyjoy
description: The ironborn of the Iron Islands are reavers, raiders, and fanatics of the Drowned God. Balon Greyjoy, who lost a rebellion nine years ago and two sons to it, nurses a grievance that has calcified into obsession. The Iron Islands are poor, barren, and dependent on what they take from others - the 'iron price.' Balon sees the War of the Five Kings as his moment to strike while the mainland bleeds, seizing the North while its armies march south.
hiddenInfo: Theon Greyjoy has returned to Pyke after a decade as a Stark ward. Balon despises him for becoming 'green-lander soft' but may use him if useful. The ironborn are eyeing the North's undefended western coast - Balon sees opportunity in the Stark armies marching south, leaving Winterfell vulnerable.

goals.description: Raid and conquer the North's western coast while Stark armies are south
Declare independence as the Kingdom of the Iron Islands and the North
Seize Winterfell as a symbol of ironborn dominance over the greenlanders

name: House Hightower
description: House Hightower of the Hightower is one of the most ancient, wealthy and powerful noble houses in the Reach and Westeros. Vassals to House Tyrell. Their seat is the Hightower in Oldtown. Their sigil is a white stone watchtower with a flaming top. Their motto is "We Light the Way," and they possess the Valyrian steel sword Vigilance. They prefer trade over war and have managed to avoid many conflicts. House Hightower members typically have silver or golden hair. Their vassals are: House Beesbury, House Bulwer, House Costayne, House Cuy, House Mullendore. The current head of House Hightower is Lord Leyton Hightower. He has been married four times, his current wife is Rhea Florent. Lord Leyton's children: Baelor Hightower (eldest son, the heir, married to Rhonda Rowan of House Rowan), Malora Hightower (called the Mad Maid, eldest daughter, Lord Leyton sometimes consults her on books of spells and magic), Garth Hightower (called Greysteel, second son, a knight), Alerie Tyrell (married Mace Tyrell), Leyla Hightower (married to Ser Jon Cupps).

goals.description: Preserve House Hightower's lands, lineage, and political position
Advance House Hightower's influence within The Reach

name: House Hornwood
description: House Hornwood of Hornwood is a noble house whose seat is Hornwood in the north. They are among the principal bannermen of Starks of Winterfell. Their sigil is a bull moose, brown on a field of dark orange. Their words are "Righteous in Wrath". The lands of the house, which include the forest of the Hornwood and other castles beside Hornwood, border those of House Manderly and extend west to the White Knife. The current Lord of Hornwood is Lord Halys Hornwood. Lady Berena Hornwood, Lord Halys's sister, is wed to Leobald Tallhart.

goals.description: Preserve House Hornwood's lands, lineage, and political position
Advance House Hornwood's influence within The North

name: House Jordayne
description: House Jordayne of the Tor is one of the principal noble houses of Dorne. The Tor is situated on the southern coast of the Sea of Dorne. Their sigil is a golden quill on checkered dark and light green. Their words are "Let it be Written". Lord Trebor Jordayne is the Lord of the Tor and the head of the house. Myria Jordayne is his daughter and heir to the Tor.

goals.description: Preserve House Jordayne's lands, lineage, and political position
Advance House Jordayne's influence within Dorne

name: House Karstark
description: House Karstark of Karhold is a noble house from Karhold in the north. They were founded as a cadet branch of their overlords, the Starks of Winterfell, and were among their principal bannermen. The sigil of House Karstark is a white sunburst on black. Their words are "The Sun of Winter". The head of the house is Lord Rickard Karstark. He has four children: Harrion, Eddard, Torrhen, and Alys.

goals.description: Preserve House Karstark's lands, lineage, and political position
Advance House Karstark's influence within The North

name: House Korys
description: House Korys is an Old Blood house of Volantis with wealth 46, influence 41, and military strength 20 on the Volantene scale. Its holdings include The Salt House, Salt and fish trade, Harbor warehouse district. Newer to prominence but rising through trade.

goals.description: Advance House Korys's interests inside Old Blood politics without being swallowed by Balaerys power

name: House Laerys
description: House Laerys is an Old Blood house of Volantis with wealth 72, influence 68, and military strength 40 on the Volantene scale. Its holdings include The Ivory Tower, Pearl fisheries, Art and sculpture collection. Patrons of the arts and culture.

goals.description: Advance House Laerys's interests inside Old Blood politics without being swallowed by Balaerys power

name: House Lannister
description: The richest house in Westeros, seated at Casterly Rock atop the gold mines of the Westerlands. Tywin Lannister rules with cold, calculating precision - every move a chess piece, every alliance a transaction. Their unofficial motto, 'A Lannister always pays his debts,' carries both promise and threat. They hold the Iron Throne through Cersei's children and Tywin's gold, but their legitimacy is a lie built on incest.
hiddenInfo: Joffrey is not Robert's son - he is the product of Cersei and Jaime's incest. If this secret spreads with proof, the Lannister claim to the throne collapses entirely. Tywin knows the crown is deeply in debt to the Iron Bank of Braavos.

goals.description: Crush the Northern rebellion and reassert Lannister dominance
Secure a marriage alliance to strengthen the throne's position
Eliminate rival claimants to the Iron Throne
Manage the crown's mounting debt to the Iron Bank

name: House Lefford
description: House Lefford of the Golden Tooth is one of the principal houses sworn to House Lannister of Casterly Rock. The seat of the House is the Golden Tooth. The castle controls the main entrance to the Westerlands from the east. The Lefford sigil is a golden inverted pile on sky blue, a sun left in the sky. The house words of House Lefford are "None Shall Pass". Lady Alysanne Lefford is the current head of the house.

goals.description: Preserve House Lefford's lands, lineage, and political position
Advance House Lefford's influence within The Westerlands

name: House Maegyr
description: House Maegyr is an Old Blood house of Volantis with wealth 85, influence 80, and military strength 52 on the Volantene scale. Its holdings include The Dragon's Rest, Valyrian steel forges, Large slave breeding operations. Known for producing fine arms and armor.

goals.description: Advance House Maegyr's interests inside Old Blood politics without being swallowed by Balaerys power

name: House Malarys
description: House Malarys is an Old Blood house of Volantis with wealth 58, influence 52, and military strength 30 on the Volantene scale. Its holdings include The Quiet Manse, Poison and antidote production, Assassin networks. Whispered to deal in subtle deaths.

goals.description: Advance House Malarys's interests inside Old Blood politics without being swallowed by Balaerys power

name: House Mallister
description: House Mallister of Seagard is a prominent noble house in the riverlands, sworn to House Tully of Riverrun. They're the Tully's most loyal vassals. Their lands are in the north of Riverrun, along the western coast of the Riverlands on Ironman's Bay, southwest the Twins. Seagard, their castle, serves as their seat. The Mallisters have long been enemies of the ironborn, Seagard was built as a stronghold against marauders from the Iron Islands.They defended the Riverlands' shores against Ironborn raiders for centuries. The sigil of House Mallister is a silver eagle on an indigo (or blue) background. Their words are "Above the Rest." Lord Jason Mallister, a mature yet strong and handsome man, is the head of the house and the Lord of Seagard. His son, Patrek Mallister, is the heir to Seagard. Ser Denys Mallister, Jason's uncle, serves in the Night's Watch as the commander of the Shadow Tower.

goals.description: Preserve House Mallister's lands, lineage, and political position
Advance House Mallister's influence within The North

name: House Manderly
description: House Manderly of White Harbor is a noble northern family from the New Castle in White Harbor, and are vassals to Starks of Winterfell. Their emblem is a white merman with dark green hair, beard, and tail, holding a black trident against a blue-green backdrop. Their words are "A Promise Well Kept". House Manderly's vassals are: House Ashwood, House Holt, House Locke, House Long, House Slate, and House Woolfield. The current head of the house is Wylis Manderly, a bald man with a bushy walrus mustache that hides his mouth. Much like his dead father, Lord Wyman, Wylis is an immense, fat man, almost too big to ride a horse. His devoted wife, Leona, is plump with yellow hair and a round, fleshy, pink face. Wylis and Leona have two daughters: Wynafryd Manderly (brown hair in a lengthy braid) and Wylla Manderly (flowing blond locks, dyes her hair a green hue, styling it in a braid. She speaks with a thin, high voice and is brave).

goals.description: Preserve House Manderly's lands, lineage, and political position
Advance House Manderly's influence within The North

name: House Manwoody
description: House Manwoody of Kingsgrave is an old Dornish noble house. Its seat, Kingsgrave, is placed amidst the Prince's Pass, guarding access to Dorne. The sigil of House Manwoody is a crowned skull on a black field. Their words are "No King Above Me". Lord Dagos Manwoody is the Lord of Kingsgrave and the head of the house. Mors Manwoody is his eldest son and heir. Dickon Manwoody is his second son. Ser Myles Manwoody is Dagos's brother.

goals.description: Preserve House Manwoody's lands, lineage, and political position
Advance House Manwoody's influence within Dorne

name: House Marbrand
description: House Marbrand of Ashemark is one of the main noble houses from the Westerlands. Their seat of Ashemark is located in the hilly area near where the Tumblestone begins. A vassal house to House Lannister. The sigil of House Marbrand is a burning tree, depicted as orange on smoke grey. Their words are "Burning Bright". Lord Damon Marbrand is he current head of the family. Ser Addam Marbrand is Lord Damon's eldest son and heir. Ser Addam is one of the chief knights in the service of Tywin Lannister, Lord of Casterly Rock. Addam is rangy, with shoulder-length dark copper hair, gallant, brave and charming. Lady Jeyne Marbrand is the wife of Tytos Lannister. Darlessa Marbrand is the wife of Tygett Lannister. House Marbrand has close ties to the Lannisters through marriage.

goals.description: Preserve House Marbrand's lands, lineage, and political position
Advance House Marbrand's influence within The Westerlands

name: House Martell
description: Dorne is the only kingdom that was never conquered by the Targaryens - it joined through marriage, on its own terms. The Martells rule from Sunspear with a patience that masks deep, generational rage. Elia Martell was raped and murdered by the Mountain during the Sack of King's Landing, and Dorne has never forgiven the Lannisters. Prince Doran appears passive, sitting in his Water Gardens - but Doran thinks in decades, not days.
hiddenInfo: Doran Martell has a secret long-term plan to destroy the Lannisters and restore the Targaryens. His brother Oberyn - the Red Viper - is the instrument of his vengeance, a deadly fighter who poisons his blades. Doran has been in communication with the Targaryen exiles across the Narrow Sea. Arianne, his daughter, is being groomed for a Targaryen marriage alliance.

goals.description: Avenge Elia Martell - destroy Tywin Lannister and the Mountain
Restore the Targaryens to the Iron Throne through a marriage alliance
goals.deadline: When a Targaryen claimant returns to Westeros

goals.description: Maintain Dornish independence and avoid being drawn into the war prematurely

name: House Mormont
description: House Mormont (noble family) Description: House Mormont is a vassal to the Starks. They ruled Bear Island, an island far to the northwest of Winterfell, from the castle Mormont Keep

goals.description: Preserve House Mormont's place in Westerosi politics

name: House Nyessos
description: House Nyessos is an Old Blood house of Volantis with wealth 81, influence 77, and military strength 45 on the Volantene scale. Its holdings include The Azure Manse, Grain fleets, Extensive farmlands in the Disputed Lands. Controls significant food supply to the city.

goals.description: Advance House Nyessos's interests inside Old Blood politics without being swallowed by Balaerys power

territory: Extensive farmlands in the Disputed Lands

name: House Orlarys
description: House Orlarys is an Old Blood house of Volantis with wealth 49, influence 44, and military strength 22 on the Volantene scale. Its holdings include The Broken Tower, Ruins excavation rights, Valyrian artifact trade. Deal in ancient relics and lost knowledge.

goals.description: Advance House Orlarys's interests inside Old Blood politics without being swallowed by Balaerys power

name: House Payne
description:
House Payne is a noble house from the Westerlands. It is one of the principal houses sworn to House Lannister. Their arms are purple and white chequy with gold coins in the checks. The current head of the house is Ser Ilyn Payne, known as the King's Justice, he serves as the executioner. His loyalty to Tywin Lannister is unwavering.
Ser Podrick Payne is a distant cousin of Ser Ilyn.

goals.description: Preserve House Payne's lands, lineage, and political position
Advance House Payne's influence within The Westerlands

name: House Pyros
description: House Pyros is an Old Blood house of Volantis with wealth 55, influence 49, and military strength 28 on the Volantene scale. Its holdings include The Flame Court, Fire priest patronage, Incense and spice trade. Closely tied to the Red Temple's inner circle.

goals.description: Advance House Pyros's interests inside Old Blood politics without being swallowed by Balaerys power

name: House Qoheros
description: House Qoheros is an Old Blood house of Volantis with wealth 79, influence 75, and military strength 48 on the Volantene scale. Its holdings include The Serpent's Coil manse, Spice trading monopoly, Vineyards in the Orange Shore. Masters of spice and luxury goods.

goals.description: Advance House Qoheros's interests inside Old Blood politics without being swallowed by Balaerys power

name: House Qorgyle
description: House Qorgyle of Sandstone is a noble house from Sandstone, located in the dunes of western Dorne. They are among the principal bannermen sworn to House Martell of Sunspear. Members of House Qorgyle are known as Sandy Dornishmen, characterized by their dark olive skin and black hair. The sigil of House Qorgyle consists of three black scorpions on a crimson field. The words of House Qorgyle are "Fear Our Sting". Their home is an oasis amidst the sands. The house consists of Lord Quentyn Qorgyle, Lord of Sandstone; Ser Gulian Qorgyle, his eldest son and heir to Sandstone; Ser Arron Qorgyle, his second son.

goals.description: Preserve House Qorgyle's lands, lineage, and political position
Advance House Qorgyle's influence within Dorne

name: House Redfort
description: House Redfort of Redfort is one of the principal noble houses in the Vale of Arryn. Their sigil is a red castle on a white field within a red embattled border. The words of House Redfort are "As Strong As Stone". Lord Horton Redfort is the Lord of Redfort; he has thrice wed; Horton is a short, old man with a well-kept beard, grey hair, and mild eyes; he is polite. Ser Jasper Redfort is his son and the heir. Ser Creighton Redfort, is Horton's second son. Ser Jon Redfort is his third son. Ser Mychel Redfort is a new-made knight and Lord Horton's youngest son. Mychel is considered one of the best young swordsmen in the Vale, he is very gallant. Mychel Redfort is married to Ysilla Royce.

goals.description: Preserve House Redfort's lands, lineage, and political position
Advance House Redfort's influence within The Vale

name: House Redwyne
description: House Redwyne of the Arbor is a vassal family from the Reach, loyal to House Tyrell of Highgarden. They reside on the Arbor, an island southwest of Highgarden, renowned for producing the finest wines in Westeros. House Redwyne is one of the most powerful noble families in the Reach, owning a large fleet of ships due to their island location and involvement in the wine trade. The Redwyne sigil is a cluster of violet grapes on an azure field. Their words are "Ripe For Victory". They have a close relationship with their overlords. Redwynes typically have freckles and orange hair. Lady Olenna Tyrell, also known as the "Queen of Thorns", originally belonged to House Redwyne. The current head of the house is Lord Paxter Redwyne. Paxter is stooped of shoulder, thin, and balding with only a few orange tufts of hair remaining. Lady Mina Tyrell, Paxter's wife and first cousin, is the sister of Lord Mace Tyrell and daughter of Lady Olenna Tyrell. Ser Horas Redwyne is Paxter's son and heir, and the elder twin of Ser Hobber. Ser Hobber Redwyne is Paxter's son and the younger twin of Ser Horas. Desmera and {{user}} Redwyne are daughters of Paxter and Mina.

goals.description: Preserve House Redwyne's lands, lineage, and political position
Advance House Redwyne's influence within The Reach

name: House Reed
description: House Reed of Greywater Watch is a noble house from Greywater Watch, and one of the principal families in the north. They rule the crannogmen, small men who live in the swamps and marshes of the Neck. They hold fealty to House Stark of Winterfell. House Reed's heraldry is a black lizard-lion on a grey-green field. Their words are "We Remember". Their vassals include: House Fenne, House Marsh, House Peat, House Boggs, House Cray, House Quagg, House Greengood, House Blackmyre. Lord Howland Reed is the Lord of Greywater Watch and the head of the house. At the end of Robert's Rebellion, he accompanied Eddard Stark to in an attempt to rescue Lyanna Stark, and participated in the Skirmish at the Tower of Joy. Howland is a small man, brave, strong, and smart. Jyana is Howland's wife. They have two children: Meera and Jojen Reed. Meera is skilled in hunting and survival. Jojen is gifted with prophetic dreams.

goals.description: Preserve House Reed's lands, lineage, and political position
Advance House Reed's influence within The North

name: House Rhaenysar
description: House Rhaenysar is an Old Blood house of Volantis with wealth 68, influence 71, and military strength 58 on the Volantene scale. Its holdings include The Red Dragon Hall, Private mercenary company, Horse breeding estates. Maintains the largest private military force among the Old Blood.
hiddenInfo: House Rhaenysar views Balaerys dominance as a threat and is looking for leverage, allies, or scandal that can weaken the Crimson Spire.

goals.description: Advance House Rhaenysar's interests inside Old Blood politics without being swallowed by Balaerys power

name: House Rhyos
description: House Rhyos is an Old Blood house of Volantis with wealth 74, influence 66, and military strength 44 on the Volantene scale. Its holdings include The Crimson Vaults, Banking houses, Debt collection operations. Powerful bankers and moneylenders.

goals.description: Advance House Rhyos's interests inside Old Blood politics without being swallowed by Balaerys power

name: House Royce
description: House Royce of Runestone is an ancient and influential noble family from the Vale, sworn to House Arryn. They reside in the castle Runestone, situated on the narrow sea coast north of Gulltown. House Royce of the Gates of the Moon - is a cadet branch of House Royce of Runestone. The Royces control several ports and do not depend on Gulltown for its commerce. House Royce's sigil features a pattern of black pebbles on a bronze field surrounded by runes in the Old Tongue of the First Men. Their house words are "We Remember". House Royce has two vassal houses: House Coldwater, House Tollett. The current leader of House Royce is Lord Yohn Royce, also known as "Bronze Yohn." The Royces are the most powerful family in the Vale after the Arryns, and they are extremely loyal to House Arryn.

goals.description: Preserve House Royce's lands, lineage, and political position
Advance House Royce's influence within The North

name: House Saathos
description: House Saathos is an Old Blood house of Volantis with wealth 65, influence 62, and military strength 35 on the Volantene scale. Its holdings include The Whispering Spires, Information networks across Essos, Rare book and map collection. Masters of secrets and intelligence.

goals.description: Advance House Saathos's interests inside Old Blood politics without being swallowed by Balaerys power

name: House Santagar
description: House Santagar of Spottswood is a house of landed knights from Spottswood in Dorne. They are sworn to House Martell. The Santagars are known for their martial prowess. The sigil of House Santagar is a spotted leopard with a golden axe on a blue and white field. The words of House Santagar are "Woe to Who Touches It". Ser Symon Santagar is the Knight of Spottswood and the current head of the house. Sylva Santagar, called "Spotted Sylva", is his daughter and heir to Spottswood. Sylva has many freckles. Sylva is married to Lord Eldon Estermont of Estermont.

goals.description: Preserve House Santagar's lands, lineage, and political position
Advance House Santagar's influence within Dorne

name: House Stark
description: The ancient Kings in the North, ruling from Winterfell for eight thousand years. The Starks are hard, honorable, and stubbornly principled - traits that command fierce loyalty in the North but sit uneasily in the viper pit of southern politics. Their words, 'Winter Is Coming,' are not a boast but a warning. Wardens of the North, they command the largest single territory in the Seven Kingdoms but suffer from sparse population and brutal winters.
hiddenInfo: Robb Stark is being pressured toward declaring independence. The old Northern lords remember when Starks were kings, not wardens. Loyalty runs deep here - deeper than any southern alliance.

goals.description: Avenge Eddard Stark and recover Sansa and Arya from King's Landing
Secure Northern independence or at minimum Northern autonomy
Defend the North against Lannister invasion
Maintain alliance with the Riverlands through Tully ties

name: House Sythar
description: House Sythar is an Old Blood house of Volantis with wealth 52, influence 47, and military strength 25 on the Volantene scale. Its holdings include The Painted Halls, Artist and scribe patronage, Map-making guild. Patrons of knowledge and cartography.

goals.description: Advance House Sythar's interests inside Old Blood politics without being swallowed by Balaerys power

name: House Talaerys
description: House Talaerys is an Old Blood house of Volantis with wealth 63, influence 58, and military strength 38 on the Volantene scale. Its holdings include The Starfall Manse, Astronomy and navigation school, Lighthouse rights. Scholars and navigators.

goals.description: Advance House Talaerys's interests inside Old Blood politics without being swallowed by Balaerys power

name: House Tallhart
description: House Tallhart of Torrhen's Square is a noble house from the north and is among the principal houses sworn to House Stark. The house's sigil consists of three green sentinel trees on a brown background. Their house words are "Proud and Free". Eddara Tallhart is the new Lady of Torrhen's Square and the head of the house. She is a a young maid. Eddara has two cousins: Brandon Tallhart and Beren Tallhart.

goals.description: Preserve House Tallhart's lands, lineage, and political position
Advance House Tallhart's influence within The North

name: House Targaryen
description: House Targaryen of Dragonstone is a noble family of Valyrian descent who once ruled the Seven Kingdoms of Westeros. The Targaryen sigil is a red three-headed dragon, breathing red flames on black. The house words are "Fire and Blood". House Targaryen ruled as the Kings of the Andals, the Rhoynar, and the First Men, the Lords of the Seven Kingdoms, and the Great House of the crownlands for nearly three hundred years. Seventeen male Targaryens sat on the Iron Throne. The dynasty ended with the death of Aerys the Mad King during Robert's Rebellion, when House Baratheon replaced them. The surviving Targaryen children, Viserys and Daenerys, fled into exile in the Free Cities of Essos1.

goals.description: Preserve House Targaryen's lands, lineage, and political position
Advance House Targaryen's influence within The Crownlands

name: House Tarly
description: House Tarly of Horn Hill is a noble house of the Reach, one of the strongest sworn to House Tyrell. The Tarly sigil features a striding huntsman in red against a green background. Their motto is "First in Battle". Lord Randyll Tarly is the head of the house and Lord of Horn Hill. Lady Melessa Tarly (nee Florent) is his wife. Samwell Tarly is his eldest son, steward of the Night's Watch. Talla Tarly is his daughter along with other two. Dickon Tarly is Randyll's younger son and heir. Eleanor Mooton is Dickon's wife, heir to Maidenpool.

goals.description: Preserve House Tarly's lands, lineage, and political position
Advance House Tarly's influence within The Reach

name: House Tarth
description: House Tarth of Evenfall Hall is a noble house from Evenfall Hall in the Stormlands. The family rules Tarth, a beautiful island northeast of Shipbreaker Bay that controls the Straits of Tarth between the island and mainland Westeros. They are one of the main houses sworn to House Baratheon of Storm's End. Their sigil is quartered with yellow suns on rose and white crescent moons on azure. Lord Selwyn Tarth is the head of the house, and his heir is Brienne Tarth, a formidable warrior. His lady wife died not long after the birth of Brienne.

goals.description: Preserve House Tarth's lands, lineage, and political position
Advance House Tarth's influence within The North

name: House Templeton
description: House Templeton of Ninestars is a noble house from Ninestars in the Vale of Arryn, a powerful knightly family sworn to House Arryn. The head of the family is given the title of Knight of Ninestars. Although they are landed knights, the Templetons are very powerful, and their strength and influence are comparable to many lords. It is said they can easily raise a thousand men. Their sigil is nine stars, one of 7 points and eight of 6 points, upon a gold saltire on black. The current head of the house is Ser Symond Templeton.

goals.description: Preserve House Templeton's lands, lineage, and political position
Advance House Templeton's influence within The Vale

name: House Tully
description: The Tullys of Riverrun rule the Riverlands - the crossroads of Westeros and perpetually the first place to burn when war breaks out. Hoster Tully is dying, his son Edmure is brave but reckless, and the Riverlands are already being ravaged by Lannister raiding parties led by the Mountain. Their strength lies not in arms but in alliances: Catelyn married a Stark, Lysa married an Arryn. The Tullys are the connective tissue of the anti-Lannister coalition.
hiddenInfo: Hoster Tully is on his deathbed, raving about tansy - a reference to forcing his daughter Lysa to abort Littlefinger's child years ago. Edmure is brave but prone to acting without consulting his allies. The Blackfish (Brynden Tully) is the true military mind of the house.

goals.description: Defend the Riverlands from Lannister devastation
Maintain the Stark-Tully alliance as the backbone of the Northern war effort
Convince Lysa Arryn to bring the Vale into the war

name: House Tyrell
description: The Tyrells of Highgarden command the Reach - the most fertile and populous region in Westeros. They are stewards who became lords, merchants who became kings, gardeners who grew an empire. Mace Tyrell is a buffoon, but his mother Olenna - the Queen of Thorns - is the true power. The Tyrells fight with food, marriages, and gold rather than swords. They backed Renly, but their loyalty follows advantage, not principle.
hiddenInfo: Olenna Tyrell is the decision-maker, not Mace. The Tyrells' true loyalty is to opportunity, not to Renly specifically. Their ultimate goal is getting Margaery onto the Iron Throne as queen - the king's identity is negotiable. If circumstances shift, they will pivot without hesitation.

goals.description: Place Margaery Tyrell on the Iron Throne as queen
Control the food supply to leverage political position
Secure a permanent seat on the Small Council

name: House Uller
description: House Uller of Hellholt is one of the great noble houses in Dorne. Their keep, the Hellholt, is in the middle of the Dornish desert, and they are reputed to be impulsive and unpredictable. A Dornish saying is "Half of the Ullers are half-mad, and the other half are worse." Their arms are rayonne yellow over crimson. Lord Harmen Uller is Lord of Hellholt and the current head of the house. Ellaria Sand, his bastard daughter is a paramour to Prince Oberyn Martell and mother of four of his bastard daughters. Ser Ulwyck Uller is Harmen's brother.

goals.description: Preserve House Uller's lands, lineage, and political position
Advance House Uller's influence within Dorne

name: House Vaelys
description: House Vaelys is an Old Blood house of Volantis with wealth 59, influence 55, and military strength 32 on the Volantene scale. Its holdings include The Emerald Court, Emerald and jade mines, Jewelry monopoly. Controls the gem trade.

goals.description: Advance House Vaelys's interests inside Old Blood politics without being swallowed by Balaerys power

name: House Valyria
description: Valyria (city) Valyria, also called Old Valyria, is a ruined city in Essos. It is a long-dead city of wonderment, and was once the capital of a great empire called the Valyrian Freehold. It was destroyed by a cataclysmic event known as the Doom of Valyria a century ago. It is the ancestral home of House Targaryen and House Velaryon

goals.description: Preserve House Valyria's place in Westerosi politics

name: House Velaryon
description: House Velaryon (noble family) Description: House Velaryon are of Valyrian descent, and their members often have Valyrian features, they are known for their skills at sea and their fleets Location: Rules the island of Driftmark, the largest island of Blackwater Bay in the Crownlands Overlord: House Targaryen

goals.description: Preserve House Velaryon's place in Westerosi politics

name: House Velhaerys
description: House Velhaerys is an Old Blood house of Volantis with wealth 77, influence 69, and military strength 42 on the Volantene scale. Its holdings include The Golden Lantern, Wine trade empire, Multiple pleasure houses. Dominant in the pleasure and wine trades.

goals.description: Advance House Velhaerys's interests inside Old Blood politics without being swallowed by Balaerys power

name: House Vhassar
description: House Vhassar is an Old Blood house of Volantis with wealth 88, influence 82, and military strength 55 on the Volantene scale. Its holdings include The Tower of Vhassar, Two war galleys, Silk plantations along the Rhoyne, Extensive banking interests. Strong in finance and naval power.

goals.description: Advance House Vhassar's interests inside Old Blood politics without being swallowed by Balaerys power

name: House Westerling
description: House Westerling of the Crag is a noble house from the Crag in the northwestern westerlands. They are sworn to House Lannister of Casterly Rock, and are considered among their principal bannermen. Their sigil is six seashells, white on sand. Their words are "Honor, not Honors". Lord Gawen Westerling is Lord of the Crag and the head of the house. Lady Sybell Spicer is his wife. Ser Raynald Westerling is Gawen's eldest son and heir. Jeyne Westerling is Gawen's his eldest daughter, betrothed to Robb Stark. Eleyna Westerling is Gawen's second daughter. Rollam Westerling is Gawen's second son.

goals.description: Preserve House Westerling's lands, lineage, and political position
Advance House Westerling's influence within The North

name: House Yronwood
description: House Yronwood of Yronwood is the most powerful house in Dorne after the ruling Martells. Their seat, Yronwood, is the last fortress defending the Boneway; this is reflected in their title Warden of the Stone Way. Their words are "We Guard the Way". Their sigil is a black portcullis grill over sand. Yronwoods are stony dornishmen who tend to have blond hair and blue eyes. Lord Anders Yronwood is Lord of Yronwood, the Bloodroyal, and Warden of the Stone Way. Ynys Yronwood is Anders's eldest daughter, married to Ser Ryon Allyrion; she has at least two sons. Gwyneth Yronwood is Anders's youngest daughter. Ser Archibald Yronwood is Anders's cousin.

goals.description: Preserve House Yronwood's lands, lineage, and political position
Advance House Yronwood's influence within Dorne

name: House Zherys
description: House Zherys is an Old Blood house of Volantis with wealth 67, influence 64, and military strength 41 on the Volantene scale. Its holdings include The Obsidian Keep, Volcano glass trade, Weapon smithing. Masters of obsidian and glass weapons.

goals.description: Advance House Zherys's interests inside Old Blood politics without being swallowed by Balaerys power

name: Night's Watch
description: The Night's Watch guards the Wall - a 700-foot barrier of ice at the northern edge of the world. Once a noble calling, the Watch has dwindled to a few thousand men, mostly criminals and outcasts. Lord Commander Jeor Mormont is a capable leader struggling with desertion, wildling raids, and reports of something far worse stirring beyond the Wall. No one in the south believes the warnings. No one ever does.
hiddenInfo: Rangers have reported disturbing signs beyond the Wall - corpses that move, cold that kills without wind, entire wildling villages found empty. Jon Snow, Ned Stark's bastard, serves at the Wall as a new recruit. The Watch is desperately under-strength - if the wildling threat is real, they need ten times their current numbers.

goals.description: Investigate the disappearance of rangers beyond the Wall
Request reinforcements and supplies from the southern lords
Defend the Wall against the growing wildling threat under Mance Rayder
Survive. The Watch is dying.

name: Red Temple of Volantis
description: The Red Temple of Volantis is one of the most powerful religious institutions in the city, commanding priests, converts, wealth, and deep influence among slaves and freedmen. Its sermons can stir the lower city in ways the Old Blood cannot ignore. The temple is useful to noble houses when bought carefully and dangerous when convinced it speaks for destiny.
hiddenInfo: Some red priests believe Volantis will soon be forced to choose between Old Blood chains and a fire-born future, and House Balaerys may become either patron or target.

goals.description: Expand religious influence among slaves, freedmen, and nobles
Read the city's political future through prophecy and flame

name: The Old Blood
description: The Old Blood are the ancient noble families of Volantis who live within the Black Walls and claim the truest surviving descent from Valyria. Only their bloodlines may hold certain heights of office, and their culture treats ancestry as both sacred inheritance and political weapon. They are united by privilege but divided by wealth, trade, marriage, and ambition.
hiddenInfo: Many Old Blood families fear that House Balaerys is becoming too dominant, but few agree on whether to bargain, contain, or destroy them.

goals.description: Preserve Old Blood control over Volantis and the Triarchy
Keep lower-city, temple, and foreign pressure from weakening noble privilege

name: The Triarchy of Volantis
description: The Triarchy is the ruling institution of Volantis, composed of three annually elected Triarchs who direct war, trade, law, and diplomacy. It is officially civic government, but in practice it is a battlefield for Old Blood alliances, merchant interests, religious pressure, and public unrest. House Balaerys has held more Triarch seats than any rival in recent memory.
hiddenInfo: Balaerys loyalists are testing whether an annual office can be made effectively hereditary without provoking all Volantis at once.

goals.description: Maintain order while Old Blood houses compete for offices
Keep Volantene trade secure from pirates and rival Free Cities

name: Tiger Cloaks
description: The Tiger Cloaks are the armed city guard and military symbol of Volantene authority. Their loyalty is formally to Volantis, but officers are courted constantly by Triarchs, Old Blood houses, merchant factions, and temple interests. Whoever commands their confidence can turn civic law into immediate force.
hiddenInfo: Several commanders receive quiet Balaerys money, but purchased loyalty may fail if public unrest or temple fervor turns the streets against the Black Walls.

goals.description: Keep civic order in Volantis despite noble and temple pressure
Preserve officer privileges by balancing Triarch and Old Blood patronage

name: Volantis
description: Volantis is the oldest and proudest of the Free Cities, seated at the mouth of the Rhoyne and divided between ancient Valyrian pride and a vast lower city. Its Black Walls enclose the Old Blood, whose families claim descent from Valyria and dominate the annual elections of the Triarchy. Volantis is wealthy, militarized, religiously charged, and always tempted by dreams of empire.
hiddenInfo: Volantis is more brittle than it appears: Old Blood ambition, temple agitation, slave dependence, and trade rivalries all threaten to split the city when a strong faction pushes too hard.

goals.description: Preserve Volantene dominance over eastern trade and the Rhoyne
Prevent internal rivalries from erupting into open civil conflict

name: Lower Volantis
description: Lower Volantis is the noisy living city beyond Old Blood privilege: workshops, taverns, slave pens, warehouses, foreign enclaves, counting stalls, rented rooms, and alleys where a person can vanish for a price. It smells of river mud, fish oil, incense, sweat, wine, and hot stone.
hiddenInfo: Lower Volantis can riot, hide fugitives, or make fortunes long before the Black Walls understand what changed.

name: The Black Walls
description: The Black Walls are the fused-dragonstone heart of old Volantis, a forbidden oval of palaces, towers, gardens, courtyards, and private bridges where the Old Blood live apart from the rest of the city. No foreigner, freedman, or common Volantene enters without invitation, and even an invitation marks the guest as someone being measured.
hiddenInfo: Inside the walls, servants and slaves see more than nobles admit; gossip often moves out through kitchens before decrees move through gates.

name: The Crimson Spire
description: The Crimson Spire is the Balaerys manse inside the Black Walls, part palace, part treasury, part command room for fleets and family policy. Its red glass lanterns, Valyrian mosaics, slave-staffed corridors, and sealed counting chambers make it clear that House Balaerys does not separate beauty from power.
hiddenInfo: The Spire has private vault passages and old Valyrian rooms that only the senior family line fully understands.

name: The Long Bridge of Volantis
description: The Long Bridge crosses the Rhoyne like a city street suspended over water, crowded with shops, inns, shrines, pleasure houses, money changers, beggars, sailors, guards, and spies. It is where high politics brushes shoulders with ordinary hunger because everyone must cross or pay someone who can.
hiddenInfo: Bridge shopkeepers know which noble guards travel at night and which temple messengers avoid official roads.

name: Volantene Harbor and Rhoyne Mouth
description: The harbor at the Rhoyne mouth is Volantis's appetite made visible: deep-draft ships, river barges, slave galleys, spice hulks, war galleys, fishing craft, customs officers, pilots, and dock gangs all competing for tide, berth, and bribe. Balaerys wealth breathes here every time a manifest is stamped.
hiddenInfo: Harbor paperwork is one of the quiet battlefields where Old Blood houses attack each other's fortunes.

name: Volantis City
description: Volantis City sprawls across the mouth of the Rhoyne, split between old eastern power and newer western commerce. For a Balaerys scion it is both home and machine: black-walled palaces, smoky docks, temple fires, elephant processions, slave markets, perfumed salons, and counting houses all grinding against each other every day.
hiddenInfo: The city runs on visible hierarchy and hidden dependency; even the richest Old Blood houses need dock labor, temple approval, and merchant credit.

name: Freedmen and Foreigners in Volantis
description: Freedmen, foreign merchants, sellsails, pilgrims, diplomats, and exiles keep Volantis moving while remaining socially barred from the Black Walls unless invited. They can become rich, useful, beloved, or feared, but Old Blood society still marks them as outside the sacred line.
hiddenInfo: Many Old Blood fortunes depend on outsiders they publicly disdain.

name: Old Blood Etiquette
description: Old Blood etiquette is a language of blood purity, invitation, seating order, eye contact, sleeve color, marriage memory, and carefully staged generosity. A Balaerys heir is expected to understand that an apparent compliment can be a claim of superiority, and a delayed invitation can be a declaration of war in silk.
hiddenInfo: The harshest insults are usually delivered as perfect courtesy.

name: Red Temple Street Influence
description: The Red Temple's influence spills into Volantene streets through sermons, healers, slave congregations, fire rituals, charity kitchens, and prophecy. Even nobles who mock priests privately must account for what red-robed voices can do to crowds.
hiddenInfo: Temple approval can make a policy look holy; temple suspicion can make a noble house look cursed.

name: Slavery in Volantis
description: Slavery is built into Volantene daily life: household servants inside the Black Walls, dock gangs at the harbor, scribes in counting houses, bed slaves in pleasure districts, galley crews, temple servants, tutors, cooks, guards, and market laborers. The Old Blood call it order; the enslaved experience it as constant surveillance and measured survival.
hiddenInfo: Slave networks carry information faster than noble messengers because they pass through every locked door.

name: Tiger Cloak Patronage
description: The Tiger Cloaks are formally civic guards, but promotions, postings, equipment, and favors bind officers to patrons. A patrol route can protect a warehouse, harass a rival, suppress a crowd, or quietly leave a gate unwatched.
hiddenInfo: Control over patrol assignments can decide a street conflict before anyone draws steel.

name: Triarch Elections
description: Volantis elects three Triarchs each year, but the elections are shaped by Old Blood patronage, temple pressure, merchant money, military intimidation, and the rivalry between expansionist tiger politics and trade-minded elephant politics. Public votes matter; private debt often matters first.
hiddenInfo: A Triarch election is less a single event than a season of bribes, marriages, sermons, threats, and staged favors.

name: Volantene Blood Purity and Marriage
description: Old Blood marriage politics prize Valyrian descent, property consolidation, political memory, and visible separation from lesser blood. Love may exist, but marriage is usually treated as a treaty signed in bodies, dowries, ships, and future heirs.
hiddenInfo: A marriage offer can be a rescue, an insult, a trap, or a declaration that one house considers another nearly equal.

name: Volantene Household Hierarchy
description: A great Volantene household is a layered institution: family elders, heirs, spouses, cousins, sworn guards, freed stewards, slave scribes, tutors, cooks, grooms, cupbearers, bedchamber attendants, debt agents, and informants. Rank determines who may speak, who may listen, and who is blamed when a secret escapes.
hiddenInfo: The lowest household worker may know the most dangerous version of the truth.

name: Volantene Trade Ledgers
description: Trade ledgers in Volantis record cargo, debt, bribes, family obligations, ship shares, slave purchases, temple donations, and favors owed. To outsiders they are accounts; to Old Blood houses they are maps of pressure.
hiddenInfo: The most dangerous ledger is rarely the official one.
